― A NOTE FROM OUR PASTOR 牧者的話

settings.title: You are welcome here, whichever language you pray in.

settings.editor: We began in 1976 with a handful of families. Today three congregations share this building, and many of our members are the children and grandchildren of the people who started it.
若您初次來訪，請放心前來，隨意入座。我們不會請您站起來自我介紹。門口的同工會為您指引兒童教室與後方停車場。
SAY HELLO 與我們聯絡

settings.title: We would rather hear from you than guess.

settings.editor: Two cards, both read by a person. A connect card reaches the pastor of the congregation you name, usually within two days. A prayer request goes to the pastors and, if you allow it, to the Wednesday prayer meeting.
您也可以致電教會辦公室，我們有會說粵語、國語及英語的同工。
Children are welcome in every service. Sunday school runs during the 11:00 hour in English and the 11:30 hour in Mandarin, and a staffed nursery is open all morning for the youngest.
Every volunteer who works with children has completed a background check and our safeguarding training.

During the 11:00 and 11:30 services, two rooms upstairs.

― OUR PASTORS 教牧同工

settings.title: Know who you are walking in to meet.

settings.editor: Each congregation has its own pastor, and all three share the same eldership. Any of them will meet you for tea without an appointment.
SENIOR PASTOR · CANTONESE
Rev. Peter Chan
Has preached here since 1998. Writes the pastor’s note in the weekly bulletin and visits the hospital every Tuesday.
PASTOR · ENGLISH
林大偉 牧師
Grew up in this church’s Sunday school. Leads the English congregation and the youth fellowship with his wife, Amy.
PASTOR · MANDARIN
Rev. Grace Wang
Planted our Mandarin congregation in 2011. Teaches the newcomers’ class and coordinates the Friday small groups.
Deacons, ministry staff, and the church office are listed on the full staff page.
GIVING 奉獻

settings.title: Giving here is worship, not a subscription.

settings.editor: Fifty years of offerings built this building, sent our first missionaries, and keep the food pantry open on Saturdays. We do not pass a plate at visitors, and no one is asked for a pledge.
奉獻是感恩的回應，不是責任。

settings.text: Mail a check or give by mail →

settings.editor: A 501(c)(3) receipt is mailed every January. Designated gifts — missions, the building fund, benevolence — can be chosen at checkout.
